UPDATE transaction_submissions

        SET
            status = 'finalized',
            confirmed_slot = $2,
            observed_commitment = 'finalized',

            last_checked_at = now(),
            confirmed_at = COALESCE(confirmed_at, now()),
            finalized_at = now(),

            failed_at = NULL,
            error_code = NULL,
            error_message = NULL

        WHERE submission_id = $1
          AND status IN (
              'submitted',
              'unknown',
              'confirmed'
          )

        RETURNING submission_id
